hook: 3 mind traps that ruin every conversation.
facts: *One*: the curse of knowledge. Tappers tapped famous songs.
They predicted *half* would guess the song. Only *2.5%* did.
*Two*: false consensus. We assume most people *agree* with us.
*Three*: the illusion of transparency. Others see *less* of your nerves.
title: Psychology Facts
